familiar.noToken: {name}'s familiar "{familiar}" has no token on this scene: the ability did not fire. Shown once per session.

reshape.offer: {name}: "{spell}" sustained - you can change the choice (once per Sustain).
reshape.gone: This sustained spell has already ended.
reshape.needSustain: Sustain the spell this round first: the choice can only be changed together with Sustaining.
reshape.wrongTurn: It is not the caster's turn: change the choice on their turn, when Sustaining.
reshape.badChoice: This option is not available now (cast rank, or it is already chosen).
reshape.stuck: The previous effect cannot be removed (protected from deletion) - the choice is unchanged.
reshape.failed: The new effect was not created - the previous one is restored, the choice is unchanged.
reshape.off: Applying effects is turned off in the module settings - the choice is not changed.
reshape.undoDenied: Cannot undo the change: the Sustain has ended, a newer change replaced it or its effect was removed.

sustain.name: Sustaining: {name}
sustain.desc: The spell is being sustained: the Sustain action is needed each of the caster’s turns. Spell effects bound to the sustaining are removed when this effect goes away.
sustain.offer: {name}: “{spell}” is sustained. Press “Sustain” once per turn; a missed turn or “Dismiss” ends the spell.
sustain.offerQuiet: {name}: "{spell}" can be sustained (the familiar ability fires on Sustain too).
sustain.pulseNoArea: {spell}: no area to template — place the pulse template manually.
sustain.gone: This sustained spell has already ended.
sustain.pick: {name} is sustaining several spells: press “Sustain” on the card of the right one.
sustain.dropped: Sustaining “{spell}” ended: removed effects without a binding — {list}.
sustain.unreachable: End of sustaining “{spell}”: could not remove bound effects on: {list}.
